External Communication

قناة مشغولة

Definition

Notification that the selected VHF working channel is congested with traffic, making immediate communication difficult.

Operational example

Vessel Cape Star, this is Port Control; channel one-six is busy, remain on standby and wait for further instructions.

Localized term
